def execute_sql(sql_query):

    connection = spark._sc._gateway.jvm.java.sql.DriverManager.getConnection(
        jdbc_url,
        jdbc_properties["user"],
        jdbc_properties["password"]
    )

    statement = connection.createStatement()

    statement.execute(sql_query)

    statement.close()
    connection.close()

storage_account = "saibdpdev"
container_name = "synapse"

bronze_path = f"abfss://{container_name}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/customer/"
silver_path = f"abfss://{container_name}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/customer/"

bronze_df = spark.read.format("parquet").load(bronze_path)
bronze_record_count = bronze_df.count()
print(f"Records Read: {bronze_record_count}")
display(bronze_df)

from pyspark.sql.functions import col, to_timestamp

bronze_df = bronze_df.withColumn(
    "last_updated_ts",
    to_timestamp(col("last_updated_ts"), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'")

# ==========================================================
# Current Schema Validation
# ==========================================================
current_schema_json = bronze_df.schema.json()
print("Current Schema:")
print(current_schema_json)

# ==========================================================
# Read Previous Schema
# ==========================================================

schema_history_df = spark.read.jdbc(
    url=jdbc_url,
    table="""
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 *
        FROM dbo.schema_history
        WHERE source_name='customer'
        ORDER BY detected_on DESC
    ) sh
    """,
    properties=jdbc_properties
)

display(schema_history_df)

# ==========================================================
# Compare Schema
# ==========================================================

if schema_history_df.count() == 0:
    print(f"First Run : No previous schema found")
    schema_changed = True
    schema_version =1
else:
    previous_schema_json = schema_history_df.first()["schema_json"]

    if current_schema_json == previous_schema_json:
        print("No schema change found")
        schema_changed = False
        schema_version = schema_history_df.first()["schema_version"]
    else:
        print("Schema change detected !!!")
        schema_changed = True
        schema_version = schema_history_df.first()["schema_version"] + 1

print(f"Schema Changed : {schema_changed}")
print(f"Schema Version : {schema_version}")

# ==========================================================
# Insert Schema History
# ==========================================================

if schema_changed:
    schema_insert_df = spark.createDataFrame(

        [
            (
                "customer",
                schema_version,
                current_schema_json,
                "NEW SCHEMA",
                "ACTIVE"
            )
        ],  [
            "source_name",
            "schema_version",
            "schema_json",
            "change_type",
            "status"
        ]
    )


    schema_insert_df.write\
            .mode("append")\
            .jdbc(
                url=jdbc_url,
                table = "dbo.schema_history",
                properties = jdbc_properties
            )
    print("Schema insert successfully")

else:
    print("No schema change detected")

watermark_df = spark.read.jdbc(

)

display(watermark_df)

# ==========================================================

if watermark_df.count() >0:

else:

print(f"Last watermark value is : {last_watermark_value}")

# ==========================================================
# Incremental Filter (CDC)
# ==========================================================

if last_watermark_value :
    df_incremental = (bronze_df
                        .filter(col("last_updated_ts") > lit(last_watermark_value))  
                    )
else:
    # First run - process everything
    print("This is first run... Processing everything...")
    df_incremental = bronze_df

incremental_record_count = df_incremental.count()
print(f"Incremental records count : {incremental_record_count}")
display(df_incremental)

# ==========================================================
# Check if Silver Delta Table Exists
# ==========================================================

from delta.tables import DeltaTable

try:
    delta_silver = DeltaTable.forPath(spark,silver_path)
    silver_exists = True
    print("Silver Delta Table Exists")
except:
    silver_exists = False
    print("Silver Delta Table Does Not Exist")

from pyspark.sql.functions import col
# ==========================================================
# First Time Silver Load
# ==========================================================

if not silver_exists:

    print("First Run - Creating silver delta table...")

    # First run: all incremental records are inserts
    insert_count = incremental_record_count
    update_count = 0

    df_incremental.write \
        .format("delta")\
        .mode("overwrite") \
        .save(silver_path)

    print(f"Silver Table Created Successfully with {incremental_record_count} records.")
    print(f"Insert Count : {insert_count}")
    print(f"Update Count : {update_count}")
else:
    print("Silver delta table exists... Performing Delta Merge")

    # Read existing Silver as DataFrame
    silver_df = spark.read.format("delta").load(silver_path)

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 1 - Calculate Insert Count
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    df_new_records = (
        df_incremental.alias("source")
        .join(
            silver_df.alias("target"),
            on="customer_id",
            how="left_anti"
        )
    )

    insert_count = df_new_records.count()

    print(f"Insert Count : {insert_count}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 2 - Find Matching Records
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    df_matching_records = (
        df_incremental.alias("source")
        .join(
            df_silver.alias("target"),
            on="customer_id",
            how="inner"
        )
    )
            
    df_updated_records = (
    df_matching_records.filter(
        (col("source.city") != col("target.city")) |
        (col("source.created_date") != col("target.created_date")) |
        (col("source.customer_status") != col("target.customer_status")) |
        (col("source.date_of_birth") != col("target.date_of_birth")) |
        (col("source.email") != col("target.email")) |
        (col("source.first_name") != col("target.first_name")) |
        (col("source.gender") != col("target.gender")) |
        (col("source.last_name") != col("target.last_name")) |
        (col("source.phone_number") != col("target.phone_number")) |
        (col("source.state") != col("target.state")) |
        (col("source.zip_code") != col("target.zip_code"))
    )
)    

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 3 - Update Count
    # (We'll implement this next)
    # ------------------------------------------------------
    update_count = df_updated_records.count()

    print(f"Update Count : {update_count}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 4 - Delta Merge
    # ------------------------------------------------------
    delta_silver.alias("target")\
        .merge(df_incremental.alias("source"),
        "target.customer_id = source.customer_id"
        )\
        .whenMatchedUpdateAll() \
        .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()\
        .execute()
    print("Delta MERGE completed successfully..")
